reviews.text: The best vet we've ever had
Thank you Vicente for taking such good care of Luna, how lucky we were to have you close by whenever we needed you.
My little dog Nela goes there delighted, since Vicente treats her like family, a great professional who knows very well what he's talking about.
Today we took our puppy there for the first time and we are truly delighted with the service. 100%

The care Vicente gave both my dog ​​and me was outstanding. He always looked out for my pet's well-being, helping me understand her aging process and her decline, and supporting me during a crucial time.
I am truly grateful.
Vicente is wonderful; he's taken care of all three of my dogs. And now he's taking care of my Pepito with so much patience. 👏👏 …
Very professional
Vicente, a highly recommended veterinarian, is a very good professional and his explanations are clear.
He's been my family's vet for over 30 years and has always provided excellent care. I wish there were more vets with his commitment, honesty, helpfulness, and expertise.
"Family vet" is the best way to describe him; approachable, clear, and always spot on. We're so lucky to have him.
It's our first time here, and honestly, we loved it!! The man was very kind and treated the puppy very well; we loved it.
Vicente takes exceptional care of my dog ​​Flor. He's very professional, caring, and always ready to help with anything that happens to Flor. He's the best! Impeccable service. 100% recommended.

My cat wasn't feeling well, so we took her to this veterinary clinic. After some tests, she was diagnosed with hyperthyroidism. She's currently undergoing treatment, and we visit the clinic occasionally. I really liked the doctor's approach; he's calm, explains everything clearly, gets along well with animals, and you can call him with any questions. I love everything about it! 🙏💗

My whole life with Vicente. He cares for my pets with exquisite professionalism and affection.
My pets' lifelong veterinarian. I have immense confidence in him. Without a doubt, the best veterinarian.

A veterinarian who has treated my pets and those of my family for many years. Excellent service, unbeatable advice, and above all, he treats pets with immense care at all times. It's highly unlikely he'll change. He treated my cat a few days ago and made the right choice. I'm incredibly grateful. His prices are always very reasonable.

Very attentive and always available.
A veterinarian with a big heart.

Many thanks to the doctor for the excellent explanation, time, and attention given to our cat. We came with some questions, and he answered all the answers we needed. We highly recommend this veterinary hospital!
Can they help sick budgies?

Vicente is a very caring and attentive veterinarian. He's very patient and explains everything very well. I've been taking my dog ​​Nemo to him for over eight years and I'm very happy, even though my little guy has significant skin problems.

I really liked it. I went for something very simple and I trust it; it was a very good experience, just as I'd been told.

For now, it's going to be where I take my cats when they need something :)

Vicente is wonderful with Melocotón!

I want to give Vicente the highest rating for how he treats my dog ​​and the attention he shows us every time we have to go.

Thank you, Vicente!
Vicente, a 10

An excellent and trustworthy professional, it's clear she's in this because she loves animals, not to make money with unnecessary tests or treatments.
A 10 out of 10 as a professional.

Vicente the vet—I don't think there's a single vet in Valencia who treats animals and their owners better. Above all, he's a wonderful person, unlike other vets who are only there to take your money and give you false hope so you keep paying. Vicente will definitely be my vet for all my dogs.

I'm delighted with Vicente. I took my dog ​​to him on a friend's recommendation because they couldn't find the right medication, and it was definitely the right decision. He's incredibly kind and provides a great sense of calm (which is essential during difficult times with a dog who has a terminal illness). Without a doubt, I'll continue to use him for any future dogs I have, even though he's not exactly close to me. 100% recommended.

Vicente, the vet, is great. He has the knowledge you'd expect from a good professional, and he also cares deeply not only about the animals' well-being but also about that of their owners :) We always feel like we're in good hands.
